name: spec_qa
description: Spec-grounded Q&A: answer several sub-questions about a fixed set of specification documents, one-by-one, using each spec's ORIGINAL wording and language, then join the answers with ';' in question order. Generic - the number of questions, their order, their answers and which spec each targets are all derived from the inputs, never hard-coded. The spec documents are a fixed knowledge base retrieved per question.

task_description.description: The question text, verbatim, including the full list of sub-questions (Q1, Q2, ...) and any group headers. The skill parses the questions, their order and their group routing from this text.

spec_dir.description: Name (or path) of the directory holding the specification documents declared in the question. Relative names resolve against the question directory. Optional; inferred from the question's declared directory when omitted.
